chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 0278 — The black ring devours Shao Yanong and a Primal Fiendgod
chapter_meta_description: Shao Yanong and Xiangliu Fang are destroyed by a hidden soul-targeting treasure. Ji Ning becomes a fugitive, facing the wrath of the Shaoyan clan and the threat of Immortal time-reversal.
og_description: Ji Ning's hidden treasure activates, instantly killing an ancient Fiendgod and the heir to an imperial clan. Now a hunted fugitive, he must flee before Celestial Immortals use time-reversal to find him.
twitter_title: DE 0278 — They never saw it coming
twitter_description: A one-shot soul treasure obliterates two seemingly unbeatable enemies. Ji Ning walks a path of no return.

surfaces: Four Young Masters of the Grand Xia's capital
lore_anchors.definition: A title referring to the four most prestigious and powerful heirs of the imperial capital's ancient clans.
The highest hereditary noble title within the Shaoyan clan of the Grand Xia Dynasty.
